schemeDetail.faqMultipleQ: Can I apply for multiple schemes?

Where two schemes overlap, the rules point you at the one that fits — that is the “try instead” note on your matches.

judgeTour.label: Judge walkthrough · {current}/{total}
judgeTour.problemBody: A Scheduled Caste entrepreneur cannot easily answer two questions: which government credit scheme fits me, and which of the 100+ Channel Partners near me is authorised to process that one. Today they guess.
judgeTour.problemTip: The whole journey works without an account. “Check my eligibility” is the front door.
judgeTour.intakeTitle: Four steps, saved as you go
judgeTour.intakeBody: Each step saves as you leave it, so losing signal on a 2G connection costs one screen and not the whole form.
judgeTour.intakeTip: Step 1 is what the rules read. Step 2 is what a partner officer reads — it can never change a verdict.
judgeTour.dashboardTitle: Every figure from the real database
judgeTour.dashboardBody: Profile completion, the best match, what is left to borrow, and where the application stands.
judgeTour.dashboardTip: Nothing here is a placeholder. Seed scripts populate every screen from Postgres before the demo starts.
judgeTour.verdictBody: Not a model. The same profile against the same rule pack gives byte-identical output every time, and the pack is versioned.
judgeTour.verdictTip: The line under the results names the engine version and the rule-pack hash that produced them.
judgeTour.explainBody: Each result carries matched_because[] and blocked_because[], and each of those carries a rule id. Where a scheme does not fit, the gap is shown against the requirement.
judgeTour.explainTip: Open “View eligibility” on any card, then “Why not this scheme?” on one that was blocked.
judgeTour.calculatorBody: EMI with a moratorium, principal against interest across the tenure, and a repayment plan the citizen can print and carry to the branch.
judgeTour.calculatorTip: The rates come from the rule pack, where every figure carries a source_url and a last_verified_on.
judgeTour.partnersBody: Every pin is a branch at its own coordinates out of the PostGIS registry — State Channelising Agencies, public sector banks, RRBs and NBFC-MFIs.
judgeTour.partnersTip: The interesting thing is the absence: a district with banks but no SCA cannot process the schemes that route only through one.
judgeTour.assistantTitle: The assistant explains; it never decides
judgeTour.assistantBody: It answers from a context pack built out of the published rule pack and the engine's own verdicts, in the citizen's language, and restates what the rules decided rather than reaching its own conclusion.
judgeTour.assistantTip: With no model configured it still answers, deterministically. The model makes the words better and is never load-bearing.
judgeTour.applicationBody: The draft is filled from the profile, the citizen confirms it, and it goes to a partner authorised for that loan category. SamarthSetu never lends.
judgeTour.applicationTip: The reference number tracks it without an account. The API walkthrough, with runnable requests, is at /demo.

ekyc.cardBody: Record a four-second selfie clip on this device, so a Channel Partner can see you completed a liveness step before you reach the counter.
ekyc.badge: Liveness capture · not a UIDAI check
ekyc.title: e-KYC Video Capture
ekyc.sub: A four-second selfie clip, recorded and checked entirely on your own device. Nothing is uploaded.
ekyc.readyBody: Tap Start camera, place your face inside the outline, then record a four-second clip.
ekyc.deniedBody: Your browser refused the camera, or this device has none. You can still use every other part of SamarthSetu.

check.cameraLive: Camera is live and producing frames
check.clipRecorded: Clip recorded for the full four seconds

ekyc.privacyNote: Your video never leaves this device. The clip is held in memory, checked, and discarded — only a completion flag and a reference are stored.
ekyc.notVerified: This does not verify you against your Aadhaar record. SamarthSetu has no UIDAI Aadhaar Face Auth integration, so no face is compared to a government photograph. A Channel Partner still performs identity verification.
ekyc.failedBody: The capture did not complete. Check that the camera is not covered or in use by another app, then try again.

govId.cardBody: The last four digits of the ID you will present, so a Channel Partner can match your file and your application form arrives pre-filled.
govId.title: Which ID will you present?
govId.body: A Channel Partner matching your file asks which ID you registered. Four digits answer that. They are not enough to identify you, which is why they are the part that may be kept.
govId.hint: The last four digits only, e.g. 1234.
govId.errTooLong: That is more than four digits. Enter only the last four — never the whole number.
govId.neverFull: SamarthSetu never asks for a full Aadhaar number and cannot store one. If you paste the whole number here it is refused, not shortened.
govId.storedOnDevice: Kept on this device only. Nothing is sent anywhere.
